sponsored.t: Relates to adopting the standards of the International code council for the design, fabrication and assembly of factory manufactured homes
sponsored.sum: Directs the uniform fire prevention and building code to adopt the International Code Council (ICC)/MBI 1200-2021 Standard for Off-site Construction: Planning, Design, Fabrication and Assembly, ICC/MBI 1205-2021 Standard for Off-site Construction, and ICC/MBI 1210-2023 Standard for Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing Systems, Energy Efficiency and Water Conservation in Off-site Construction: Inspection and Regulatory Compliance relating to factory manufactured homes; permits third party review of factory manufactured homes.

sponsored.t: Relates to the adoption of the Mass Timber International Building Code (IBC) Standard Type IV-A, IV-B, and IV-C
sponsored.sum: Directs the adoption of the Mass Timber International Building Code (IBC) Standard Type IV-A, IV-B, and IV-C by the state fire prevention and building code council; directs the NYC commissioner of buildings to submit the code for adoption by the city council.

sponsored.t: Relates to deadline for the processing of building permits by local governments and the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Requires local building departments to process and approve or deny applications for residential or mixed-use buildings within 30 days; provides that if the local department does not process the application within the required timeframe an applicant shall be permitted to retain a private professional to perform the permit review to determine compliance with state and/or local building codes.

sponsored.t: Establishes multidisciplinary personnel teams
sponsored.sum: Establishes multidisciplinary personnel teams to ensure prompt, coordinated, and confidential sharing of information among professionals for effective identification, assessment, and delivery of housing and supportive services.

sponsored.t: Enacts the Public Health Modernization Act
sponsored.sum: Directs the department to repeal subpart 24-2 of part 24 of title 10 of the New York Codes, Rules and Regulations in its entirety and promulgate new rules and regulations governing the licensing and operation of certain commercial establishments.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "freedom to read act"
sponsored.sum: Requires each board of education to adopt a written policy for reconsideration of school library materials and make such policy available on its website; requires such policies to include provisions for the creation of a reconsideration committee to review complaints regarding school library materials; requires the commissioner of education to develop one or more model policies for school districts.

sponsored.t: Enacts the psychology interjurisdictional compact
sponsored.sum: Adopts the psychology interjurisdictional compact to increase public access to psychological services by allowing telepsychological practice and temporary in-person services across state lines.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the dormitory authority to provide financing to Vanderbilt University for the construction of facilities
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the dormitory authority to provide financing to Vanderbilt University for the construction of facilities.

sponsored.t: Requires state and county boards of elections to post sample ballots online at least twelve days prior to the first day of early voting
sponsored.sum: Requires state and county boards of elections to post sample ballots online at least twelve days prior to the first day of early voting; requires such ballots to be posted in a searchable database.

sponsored.t: Exempts certain parcels of land from licensing restrictions relating to alcoholic beverages
sponsored.sum: Exempts certain parcels of land from licensing restrictions prohibiting manufacturers, wholesalers and retailers of alcoholic beverages from sharing an interest in a licensed premises and from selling at retail for consumption on the premises.

sponsored.t: Relates to prescription labels for gonadotropin-releasing hormone agonists, pubertal suppressants, anabolic steroids, alpha reductase inhibitors, progestins, or drug classes for hormone replacement therapy
sponsored.sum: Provides that prescription labels for gonadotropin-releasing hormone agonists, pubertal suppressants, anabolic steroids, alpha reductase inhibitors, progestins, or drug classes for hormone replacement therapy maybe include the name of the dispensing practice instead of the prescriber; provides for notice to patients.

sponsored.t: Prohibits octopus farming
sponsored.sum: Provides that no person shall engage in the operation of a marine hatchery or in the off-bottom or on-bottom culture of any species belonging to the order Octopoda unless for scientific or educational purposes for the purpose of human consumption.

sponsored.t: Exempts certain parcels of land from licensing restrictions prohibiting manufacturers, wholesalers and retailers of alcoholic beverages from sharing an interest in a licensed premises; repealer
sponsored.sum: Exempts certain parcels of land from licensing restrictions prohibiting manufacturers, wholesalers and retailers of alcoholic beverages from sharing an interest in a licensed premises and from selling at retail for consumption on and off the premises.

sponsored.t: Requires employment entities to engage in cooperative dialogue with certain persons regarding reasonable accommodations
sponsored.sum: Requires employment entities to engage in cooperative dialogue with persons requesting reasonable accommodations, or who such employment entities reasonably should have known may require such reasonable accommodations, due to disability, religion, or status as a victim of domestic violence.

sponsored.t: Relates to obtaining jurisdiction over certain defendants in matters relating to a tenancy or lease
sponsored.sum: Standardizes the language across the relevant court acts to allow tenants statewide to sue in the county where the real property at issue is located in matters relating to a tenancy or lease; requires the Office of Court Administration to develop necessary forms, procedures and deliver a report.

sponsored.t: Requires certain construction project contracts to include siting of renewable energy systems, qualified energy storage systems, or electric major utility transmission facilities
sponsored.sum: Requires certain construction project contracts with a value of greater than or equal to five million dollars to include siting of renewable energy systems, qualified energy storage systems, or major electric transmission facilities.

sponsored.t: Relates to HIV testing in certain criminal cases
sponsored.sum: Relates to the time when court ordered HIV testing in certain criminal cases must be conducted.

sponsored.t: Provides for inclusive instruction and instructional materials
sponsored.sum: Requires school districts and charter schools to establish a task force to make recommendations on model curriculum or instruction on the political, economic, and social contributions of lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer, intersex, and asexual people, in an appropriate place in the curriculum of middle school and high school students.

sponsored.t: Authorizes retail licensees to purchase alcohol with a business payment
sponsored.sum: Authorizes retail licensees to purchase alcohol with a business payment card.

sponsored.t: Relates to expanding the definition of interim multiple dwelling to provide protections for certain residents
sponsored.sum: Expands the definition of interim multiple dwelling (lofts) to provide protections for certain remaining, long time residents.

sponsored.t: Relates to granting Gabrielle Tessler continued health coverage in retirement
sponsored.sum: Provides for continued health coverage in retirement for certain NYC employees who transferred departments.

sponsored.t: Relates to the creation of a public database of projects funded in the state budget
sponsored.sum: Relates to the creation of a public database of projects funded in the state budget.

sponsored.t: Relates to outdoor alcohol service for certain special events
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the liquor authority to permit outdoor alcohol service for certain special events occurring in June and July, 2026.

sponsored.t: Relates to cases terminated due to mental disease or defect and to establishing reporting obligations regarding such cases
sponsored.sum: Relates to cases terminated due to mental disease or defect and to establishing reporting obligations regarding such cases.

sponsored.t: Relates to web-based videoconferencing of public meetings
sponsored.sum: Makes various amendments to requirements for web-based videoconferencing of public meetings; establishes the municipal hybrid meeting trust fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to injury of domestic and companion animals by motorists
sponsored.sum: Requires motorists to exercise care to avoid colliding with any domestic or companion animal; increases fines and penalties for causing such injury and for leaving the scene of injury to certain animals without reporting.

sponsored.t: Requires health insurance policies to include coverage of optional anesthesia for certain contraceptive and menstrual health procedures
sponsored.sum: Requires health insurance policies to include coverage of optional anesthesia for certain contraceptive and menstrual health procedures including, but not limited to, loop electrosurgical excision procedure, colposcopy, ablation, and intrauterine device insertion.

sponsored.t: Relates to unlawfully deceptive acts or practices regarding environmental marketing claims
sponsored.sum: Prohibits certain unlawfully deceptive acts or practices involving environmental marketing claims.

sponsored.t: Relates to discrimination against owners of specific breeds of dog
sponsored.sum: Relates to discrimination against owners of specific breeds of dogs.

sponsored.t: Relates to promoting animal fighting; repealer
sponsored.sum: Enhances and enacts provisions relating to criminalizing the promotion of animal fighting and appropriately punishing individuals associated with such activities.

sponsored.t: Requires state agencies to prepare an active intelligent speed assistance system plan for the equipment of all state agency vehicles with active intelligent speed assistance systems
sponsored.sum: Requires state agencies to prepare an active intelligent speed assistance system plan for the equipment of all state agency vehicles with active intelligent speed assistance systems, and to equip state agency vehicles with such systems by certain dates.

sponsored.t: Prohibits regulations from permitting an owner to refuse to renew a lease on grounds that the housing is sought for personal use or occupancy; repealer
sponsored.sum: Prohibits certain regulations of the state division of housing and community renewal, for cities having a population of less than one million and towns and villages, from permitting an owner to refuse to renew a lease on grounds that the housing accommodation is sought for personal use or occupancy (i.e. use or occupancy by the owner or the owner's immediate family); repeals provisions which permit evictions for personal use and occupancy.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of biometric surveillance system or biometric surveillance information in places of public accommodation
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of biometric surveillance system or biometric surveillance information in places of public accommodation; prohibits entering into any agreement that authorizes any third party to use any biometric surveillance system or biometric surveillance information; provides penalties for violations.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of injurious physical force by public servants
sponsored.sum: Relates to the use of injurious physical force by public servants; directs the commissioner of criminal justice services and the commissioner of health to prescribe standards for the use of physical force and for devices and substances used in the exercise of physical force.

sponsored.t: Relates to removing citizenship as a qualification for holding public office
sponsored.sum: Removes citizenship as a qualification for holding public office in this state unless required by law.

sponsored.t: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of environmental conservation to conduct a study on food waste initiatives and to provide recommendations based on the study's findings
sponsored.sum: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of environmental conservation to conduct a study on food waste initiatives and to provide recommendations based on the study's findings.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring landlords of certain properties to furnish New York homes and community renewal with data pertaining to succession rights
sponsored.sum: Requires landlords of certain properties to furnish New York homes and community renewal with data pertaining to succession rights.

sponsored.t: Directs a study on the feasibility and impact of urban consolidation centers and shared use locker technologies
sponsored.sum: Directs a study on the feasibility and impact of urban consolidation centers and facilities that combine multiple deliveries from different suppliers to a central location to be delivered inside the service area, and shared use locker technologies as final delivery locations.

sponsored.t: Relates to contracts to provide food services at transportation facilities and rest areas owned and operated by certain public authorities
sponsored.sum: Requires that food services at transportation facilities and rest areas owned and operated by certain public authorities remain open seven days a week.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing certain providers of services to administer and dispense methadone or other controlled substances
sponsored.sum: Relates to requirements for certain providers of services to be authorized to administer and dispense methadone or other controlled substances, including the establishment of a community advisory board.

sponsored.t: Relates to requirements for reducing emissions from medium and heavy-duty vehicles
sponsored.sum: Enacts an advanced clean fleets law to reduce vehicle emissions for medium- and heavy-duty vehicles.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the adjustment of maximum allowable rent where any modification, increase or improvement is made to accommodate the needs of a disabled tenant
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the adjustment of maximum allowable rent where any modification, increase or improvement is made to accommodate the needs of a disabled tenant; defines disabled tenant.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring qualification-based criteria for awarding certain contracts for services
sponsored.sum: Requires qualification-based criteria for awarding certain contracts for services.

sponsored.t: Relates to offering false information on documents to obtain a building permit
sponsored.sum: Includes filing certain building permit applications containing false statements regarding tenant occupancy in the offense of offering a false instrument for filing in the first degree.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring property owners to dedicate certain residential units to rent regulated status following demolition and new construction or substantial renovation
sponsored.sum: Requires property owners to dedicate certain residential units to rent regulated status following demolition and new construction or substantial renovation.

sponsored.t: Creates the health insurance guaranty fund
sponsored.sum: Creates the health insurance guaranty fund to protect covered individuals against the failure or inability of a health insurer to perform its contractual obligations due to financial impairment or insolvency.

sponsored.t: Relates to the applicability of local laws of certain cities to buildings owned, leased or operated by the state or its agencies
sponsored.sum: Requires full compliance with local building codes upon alteration of a state owned building or if such building ceases to be owned by the state.

sponsored.t: Relates to wrongful refusal of admission to and ejection from places of public entertainment and amusement
sponsored.sum: Includes sporting events within the definition of places of public entertainment and amusement for purposes of wrongful refusal of admission to and ejection from places of public entertainment and amusement.

sponsored.t: Relates to restrictions on certain flight operations at municipal facilities; relates to the use of certain heliports
sponsored.sum: Prohibits municipal corporations from permitting the use of publicly owned land for helicopter air transportation operated for the primary purpose of conducting sightseeing tours over New York city or conducting photography, videography, or similar production activities over New York city; relates to the use of certain heliports in the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "nonpublic dignity for all students act"
sponsored.sum: Prohibits discrimination against and harassment or bullying of students by employees or students on private, religious or denominational school property or at a school function; provides immunity from civil liability for a person making a good faith report of discrimination, harassment or bullying to authorities.

sponsored.t: Allows authorized representatives to apply for identification cards
sponsored.sum: Allows authorized representatives to apply to the DMV for identification cards on behalf of qualified applicants.

sponsored.t: Exempts senior citizens aged 72 and older from jury duty
sponsored.sum: Exempts senior citizens aged 72 and older from jury duty due to physical health and/or mobility issues.

sponsored.t: Relates to an electronically submitted absentee ballot application and absentee ballot
sponsored.sum: Relates to an electronically submitted absentee ballot application and absentee ballot.

sponsored.t: Relates to banning the use of biometric identifying technology in schools
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of biometric identifying technology in schools for any reason other than certain specified purposes; adds fingerprint identification of teachers, administrators and students for the purpose of securely logging into a digital device for academic and administrative purpose to allowable purposes.

sponsored.t: Requires the surrender of registration and license plates for a suspended or revoked license
sponsored.sum: Requires the surrender of registration and license plates for a suspended or revoked license.

sponsored.t: Permits the sale of tonic water, bitters, maraschino cherries and dealcoholized wine at liquor stores
sponsored.sum: Permits the sale of tonic water, bitters, maraschino cherries and dealcoholized wine at liquor stores.

sponsored.t: Relates to educational materials pertaining to sexual health to individuals enrolled in Medicaid
sponsored.sum: Requires social services districts to distribute educational materials pertaining to sexual health, including information on HIV prevention and pre-exposure prophylaxis to individuals enrolled in Medicaid.

sponsored.t: Relates to the minimum age to vote at school district meetings
sponsored.sum: Lowers the minimum age to vote at school district meetings and for the election of school district officers from 18 to 16.

sponsored.t: Permits tenants in certain cities to take a rental offset for repair of hazardous conditions
sponsored.sum: Provides that in cities with a population of one million or more, a tenant or group of tenants, after proper notice to the landlord of the existence of a hazardous violation of housing codes and certification of the existence of such violation by the local agency charged with enforcement of housing codes, may contract for the repair of such condition and offset the price of such repair from their rental payments if the landlord fails to commence work to correct the condition within a certain period after notice is received.

sponsored.t: Relates to eligibility under the green building tax credit
sponsored.sum: Provides that residential buildings shall be deemed eligible buildings for the green building tax credit.

sponsored.t: Provides for the waiver of the fee for a replacement driver's license or identification card
sponsored.sum: Provides for the waiver of the fee for a replacement driver's license or identification card if the replacement driver's license or identification card is requested solely for the purpose of designating that the applicant is an organ donor.

sponsored.t: Relates to the service life requirement for painting, striping and other new infrastructure dedicated primarily for pedestrian or cyclist use
sponsored.sum: Enables federal aid municipal street and highway funding for projects for painting, striping and other new infrastructure dedicated primarily for pedestrian or cyclist use notwithstanding the ten year service life requirement.

sponsored.t: Relates to an elder court pilot program
sponsored.sum: Creates an elder court pilot program to study the effectiveness of senior-specific judicial programming especially involving elder abuse and domestic violence.

sponsored.t: Relates to health education pertaining to cannabis
sponsored.sum: Requires schools to provide for health education pertaining to cannabis use.

sponsored.t: Relates to a pharmacy's obligation to properly dispense or refill a prescription for a drug or device, or a non-prescription drug or device
sponsored.sum: Provides that a pharmacy is obligated to properly dispense or refill a prescription for a drug or device, or a non-prescription drug or device regardless of the ethical, moral or religious beliefs of any employee of such pharmacy.

sponsored.t: Relates to housing navigation services for those with intellectual and developmental disabilities
sponsored.sum: Establishes a curriculum and task force to provide housing navigation services for those with intellectual and developmental disabilities.

sponsored.t: Requires the posting of broker and management information on commercial property
sponsored.sum: Requires the posting of broker and property management information on the window of commercial property that has been vacant for at least one month.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of accrued vacation time
sponsored.sum: Allows New York state employees to use accrued vacation time toward student loan payments; defines terms; requires the president of the civil service commission to promulgate necessary rules and regulations.

sponsored.t: Includes a class three bicycle with electric assist in the definition of limited use motorcycle
sponsored.sum: Includes a class three bicycle with electric assist in the definition of limited use motorcycle.

sponsored.t: Relates to expanding the right of publicity
sponsored.sum: Expands the right of publicity to seventy years following the death of a deceased personality; makes the provisions of such section granting a right of publicity applicable to all deceased persons until the end of such 70 year period.

sponsored.t: Relates to medical assistance coverage for medically tailored meals
sponsored.sum: Requires medical assistance coverage for medically tailored meals and medical nutrition therapy for the purpose of disease management.

sponsored.t: Relates to year-round outdoor dining
sponsored.sum: Requires municipalities which permit sidewalk and roadway cafes to permit year-round outdoor dining.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the commissioner of health to make grants to be used to help pay for the costs of conducting local blood drives
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the commissioner of health to make grants to not-for-profit organizations and elementary, secondary and postsecondary schools to be used to help pay for the costs of conducting local blood drives.

sponsored.t: Establishes a personal income tax deduction for the interest paid on student loans by certain taxpayers
sponsored.sum: Establishes a personal income tax deduction for the interest paid on student loans by individual taxpayers having a federal adjusted income of between $65,000 and $125,000, and married taxpayers filing jointly having a federal adjusted income of between $130,000 and $250,000.

sponsored.t: Relates to the imposition of sales tax on the sale of race horses made through claiming races
sponsored.sum: Expands the imposition of sales tax on the sale of race horses made through claiming races to include the total sale price on each sale.

sponsored.t: Relates to the imposition of sales tax on admission to places of amusement
sponsored.sum: Amends the imposition of sales tax to dramatic or musical arts performances, or live circus performances, or motion picture theaters, where such admission charge is not more than one thousand dollars.

sponsored.t: Prohibits discrimination against individuals who have tested positive for HIV with respect to insurance coverage
sponsored.sum: Prohibits discrimination against individuals who have tested positive for HIV with respect to life, accident, and health insurance coverage.

sponsored.t: Clarifies the right of publicity
sponsored.sum: Clarifies the right of publicity including the definitions of who and what qualifies as a digital replica; provides guidance as to digital replicas that do not violate an individual or deceased individual's right to publicity; expands the statute of limitations for an action brought for violating an individual's right to publicity.

sponsored.t: Relates to permitting  A Beautiful Noise, LLC  to file an application for a New York city musical and theatrical production tax credit for 2022
sponsored.sum: Permits "A Beautiful Noise, LLC" to file an application for a New York city musical and theatrical production tax credit for 2022.

sponsored.t: Prohibits law enforcement officers from wearing any mask or personal disguise while interacting with the public in the performance of their duties
sponsored.sum: Prohibits local, state and federal law enforcement officers from wearing any mask or personal disguise while interacting with the public in the performance of their duties; excludes certain protective masks.

sponsored.t: Eliminates nonprofit tax exemptions for entities engaged in political activity
sponsored.sum: Eliminates nonprofit tax exemptions for entities engaged in political activity.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "reporting of arrests, detentions, actions and removals by immigration enforcement (RADAR) act"
sponsored.sum: Requires the creation of an immigration enforcement activity transparency dashboard, which shall be made publicly available, to track certain information relating to immigration authorities activities within New York state.

sponsored.t: Repeals certain provisions regarding adoption of new or revised city charter proposed by charter commission which limit submission of questions to city's electors
sponsored.sum: Repeals certain provisions regarding the adoption of a new or revised city charter proposed by a charter commission which limits the submission of questions to a city's qualified electors; eliminates the rule that provides that whenever a city charter commission puts a proposal on the local ballot, all other local referendum proposals are barred from the ballot.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 63 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Assembly Bill Number 3665-A, entitled: "AN ACT to repeal paragraphs (e), (f) and (g) of subdivision 5 of section 36 of the municipal home rule law, relating to limitations on the submitting of a question to the qualified electors of a city when there is a question submitted by a charter commission" NOT APPROVED The bill would amend the Municipal Home Rule Law by repealing those provisions that grant exclusive authority to a charter revision commis- sion created by a locality's executive to place charter amendment proposals or questions on the ballot for referendum. The bill would allow all charter amendment proposals or questions to be placed on the ballot, regardless of whether they originated from a charter revision commission created by the local executive or the local legislative…

sponsored.t: Relates to the tax exemption of a mutual redevelopment company
sponsored.sum: Relates to the extension of a tax exemption for a mutual redevelopment company in a city having a population of one million or more persons.

sponsored.t: Relates to the right of publicity
sponsored.sum: Relates to the right of publicity; amends the definitions of "deceased performer", "deceased personality" and "digital replica" in relation to the right of publicity; relates to the use of a deceased performer's digital replica without authorization by the applicable right holder.

sponsored.t: Enacts the freedom to read act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "freedom to read act"; requires the commissioner of education and school library systems to develop policies to ensure that school libraries and library staff are empowered to curate and develop collections that provide students with access to the widest array of developmentally appropriate materials available.

sponsored.t: Imposes certain requirements on institutions housing a defendant due to mental disease or defect prior to the discharge of such defendant
sponsored.sum: Requires each appropriate institution housing a defendant due to mental disease or defect to assign a critical time intervention care management team to the defendant and make a single point of access referral for the defendant prior to such defendant's discharge.

sponsored.t: Relates to voluntary contributions in support of municipal animal pounds or shelters
sponsored.sum: Relates to voluntary contributions in support of municipal animal pounds or shelters.

sponsored.t: Relates to ballot drop boxes for absentee and early voting ballots
sponsored.sum: Makes technical changes related to ballot drop boxes for absentee and early voting ballots.
